g.text: Zephyr userspace: two permissions, one system address map
Z2 · CONFIG_USERSPACE + supported MPU/MMU · domains protect user access, not trusted supervisor code
RAM permission is not object permission. User code may pass an authorized object pointer without being allowed to dereference it.
BLUE solid = API call | TEAL solid = data / ownership | ORANGE dashed = wake / schedule | GREY dotted = build / configuration
